title: Thoughts on my "Powered by Godot" teaser vid?
author: EthelUltima
selftext:
Godot community very much hates AI, but I really like the engine but I also like AI. Curious on your thoughts on this "Powered by Godot" trailer. If your wondering it is actually a real game, demo is on Steam.

Opus tell me how you did it:

    I wrote the whole film as code inside Godot 4.7.1, working from your notes. No AI image or video generator was involved, and nothing was hand-animated or filmed. Every pixel of the film itself was drawn by Godot; only the title card went on afterwards.
    The world: Python tools generated the mountain (a simulation of uplift and river erosion), the city’s street plan and 442,030 buildings, the atmosphere tables and the 3D icon, which came from the official SVG.
    The drawing: Godot shaders handle the Earth, ring, Moon and aurora in the sky, and the volumetric clouds. On top of those are ray-traced reflections and the engine’s own lighting.
    The bike: it’s the real CYBERBIKE running your game’s code, carried along a pre-calculated drifting and wheelie line in a separate copy of the project.
    The camera: one unbroken path with no cuts.
    The render: it runs offline, not in real time. Each 4K frame is 32 renders averaged together, which gives true motion blur and depth of field. All 1,050 frames took about 37 minutes on your RX 7900 XTX.
    The finish: the sound is the trailer’s Relink Blood track plus the game’s own effects, mixed in Python. The title card was added in Python, and ffmpeg encoded the final video.

comments.author: 314t
comments.body: Its a trailer for a game? I like it, but I'd still go without the powered by godot. There's also camps of people who hate on games made in godot, just like the camps of people who hate on games made with AI. No point in disclosing the engine you are using, I also think its funny how claude like bells for music lol

replies.author: EthelUltima
replies.body:
It's not a game trailer it's a like Unreal or Unity banner lot of games have in the intro. I was thinking of putting it in the full release along with all the other preamble during the intro. Don't want it in the demo.

My actual game trailer is on Steam if you want to see it (with more bells):  
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5350450/CYBERBIKES/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5350450/CYBERBIKES/)

replies.body: I see, if thats the case I say leave it, it does look cool. Game looks cool too, has a retro feel, not my style of game, but still cool. keep it up man!
